title: JA Fresco EmDash 0.1.0: the seed composes every page, the fonts and licences ship, the slot roles pass, the personalization map names its fields no vulnerable hono is locked and no editor text reaches the page unsanitised
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout, run `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` in packages/cms/tracy-emdash-theme-fresco (it is not a workspace member; no database, no stand, no model).
S2: From that folder run `node --test tests/composition.test.mjs tests/brand.test.mjs tests/display-locale.test.mjs tests/link-gate.test.mjs tests/data-links.test.mjs`.

S3: From the TCH root run `node scripts/slot-roles/check.mjs packages/cms/tracy-emdash-theme-fresco/contracts/0.1.0`; run `pnpm exec tsx scripts/check-emdash-kit-sync.ts`; from the package folder run `node tools/personalize.mjs --answers-json '{"name":"Casa Luna","sector":"restaurant","contact":"12 Harbour Road, Lisbon +351 21 000 000","email":"hello@casaluna.example"}' --dry-run --json`.
S4: Read the package's pnpm-lock.yaml: every `@hono/node-server` entry is 2.1.6 or later and every `hono` entry is 4.13.16 or later.

S5: In the same folder run `node --test tests/set-html-safe.test.mjs`: the about description (`features_intro/about-intro.desc`) holding ``, a script, an iframe or a javascript: link renders inert, and every `set:html` in src prints cleaned text or a constant.
expect: Every test of S2 reports ok: each section entry the views name exists in the seed, the router imports views that exist, every shipped font is local, has an OFL notice and the Vietnamese range, and the chrome entry carries every word the header and footer print.
The slot roles check passes for contracts/0.1.0 (a known role on every text and image slot of the seed, whole cards).

The personalize dry run reports `errors: 0` and lists the planned entries (`planned`); its exit code is 0, or 3 when no model key is set, because the copy and rewrite rules are then skipped by design (exit 3 means done with some copy skipped), and that is not a failure here.
The lock has no `@hono/node-server` below 2.1.6 (GHSA-jpvv-r467-5p4w, GHSA-qv5m-9pm6-hqp3) and no `hono` below 4.13.16.

The about description keeps its words and list items but loses event handlers, scripts, iframes, styles and script URLs; every `set:html` in the package goes through `cleanHtml` or prints a constant of the code.
